coarse.mapping: Exact source-knot splits; positive 8-point integration of piecewise-linear volume opacity with Planck derivative. Constant lowest opacity below first source frequency. No mean or relaxation-rate fitting.

fine.mapping: Exact source-knot splits; positive 8-point integration of piecewise-linear volume opacity with Planck derivative. Constant lowest opacity below first source frequency. No mean or relaxation-rate fitting.

scope: Conditional LTE absorption candidate on the inherited finite photon bins. Emission is defined by Kirchhoff in that candidate; this does not reclassify the native emission residual as passing. Subcell transport/line redistribution, missing atomic continua and mass/partition consistency are not bounded by the source-grid comparison.
